macro.title: US stocks hover near their latest record in mixed trading on Wall Street - AP News
macro.summary: Stocks kicked off a busy week with mixed trading on Wall Street that is keeping the market hovering around its all-time high set last week. The S&P 500 rose 0.1% Monday. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 228 points, and the Nasdaq composite slipped 0.2%. …

macro.title: Stock Market Today: Stocks Are Mixed to Begin Big Week of Earnings; Bond Market Closed Today - Investopedia
macro.summary: Major U.S. stock indexes were mixed Monday to begin a big week of bank earnings and inflation reports, while the U.S. bond market was closed.
